name: American Mahjong
description: American Mahjong is a North American Mahjong variant with a card-defined hand system and joker usage. It uses an expanded tile set compared with classical Chinese variants and emphasizes matching published hand patterns over unrestricted fan construction.

overview.description: American Mahjong is a North American Mahjong variant with a card-defined hand system and joker usage. It uses an expanded tile set compared with classical Chinese variants and emphasizes matching published hand patterns over unrestricted fan construction.

history.origins: American Mahjong developed in the United States as a structured variant with annual hand-card systems and joker rules.
timeline: Modern era: organized play uses annual pattern cards and standard tournament conventions.
history.cultural: It is widely played in organized groups and clubs with published yearly hand cards.
history.evolution: Distinct hand-card and joker mechanics separate American Mahjong from classical Chinese scoring structures.

setup.deck: American Mahjong tile set including jokers and bonus tiles.
setup.dealing: Players receive 13 tiles; dealer begins with 14 and discards first after initial exchange sequence.
setup.equipment: Mahjong set, annual hand card, dice, and table accessories.

rules.objective: Complete a legal hand listed on the active American Mahjong hand card.
rules.gameplay: Players draw and discard while aiming for a listed hand pattern. Claims and joker rules follow American conventions, including restrictions on joker use by set type and hand requirements.
keyRules: Winning hands must match listed card patterns.
Joker usage is restricted by hand and set type.
Draw-discard loop continues until legal Mahjong is declared or draw conditions end the hand.

strategy.basic: Commit early to plausible hand-card lines and avoid dead-end tile accumulation.
strategy.intermediate: Read discards and exposures to block contested lines and pivot when your route collapses.
strategy.advanced: Exploit card-density probabilities, joker constraints, and defensive discard timing to deny likely opponent completions.
tips: Do not over-commit to rare lines without backup routes.
Track exposed jokers and high-leverage tiles to infer remaining winning paths.

synthesis.shortDescription: American Mahjong uses a card-defined hand system with jokers on an expanded 152-tile set.
